hero.noTunnels: No tunnels yet — import a .conf below
tunnels.empty: No WireGuard tunnels found. Import a .conf file to add one to NetworkManager, or list wg-quick configs in the widget settings.
action.publicIp.hint: Look up the address your traffic leaves from (ipinfo.io)
action.stats.hint: Install a small root helper so handshake times and per-peer traffic can be shown
stats.hint: Optional: handshake times and per-peer traffic are only visible to root. "Enable peer stats" asks for your password once to install a read-only helper (keys stripped); nothing else needs it.
remove.message: Remove the WireGuard tunnel "%1"? This deletes its NetworkManager profile, including its keys. The .conf you imported from is not touched.
remove.activeMessage: Disconnect and remove the WireGuard tunnel "%1"? This deletes its NetworkManager profile, including its keys. The .conf you imported from is not touched.
remove.hideMessage: Stop showing "%1"? Its config in /etc/wireguard is root-owned and stays where it is. Add it back under the widget's wg-quick configs setting.
dns.shared: %1 all take every lookup, so systemd-resolved asks each of them at once and uses whichever answers first. To pick one, use Settings → Tunnel DNS.
dns.overridden: Your system DNS setting (omarchy dns) overrides tunnel DNS, so lookups skip your tunnel's DNS server. "Fix tunnel DNS" installs a small NetworkManager hook (one password prompt) that applies each tunnel's own DNS while it's connected.
action.dnsFix.hint: Install a NetworkManager dispatcher hook so WireGuard profiles' DNS servers are used while connected
action.dnsUpdate.hint: Reinstall the tunnel DNS hook so it follows the Tunnel DNS choice (one password prompt)
settings.title: Settings
settings.defaultTunnel.hint: What the master switch and right-click connect
settings.dnsTunnel.hint: Which tunnel's DNS answers lookups when several are connected. The others still answer their own domains
settings.autoPublicIp.hint: Asks ipinfo.io when the panel opens and when a tunnel goes up or down. Off: only when you click ↻.
settings.exclusive.hint: Connecting a tunnel disconnects all others. When off, only full tunnels replace each other
